a b s t r a c t
Understanding the role of forage ﬁsh  in marine food webs is an important part of ecosystem-based
ﬁsheries
 management. Food web models are a common tool used to account for important characteristics
of
 forage ﬁsh  and their trophodynamics. One primary limitation of many existing food web models is that
the
 taxonomic resolution of forage ﬁsh  and their predators is overly simpliﬁed.  Here, we developed a food
web
 model with high taxonomic resolution of forage ﬁsh  and their predators in the California Current to
more
 comprehensively describe trophic linkages involving forage ﬁsh  and examine the ecological role
of
 forage ﬁsh  in this system. We parameterized a mass-balanced food web model (Ecopath) with 92
living
 functional groups, and used this to quantify diet dependency on forage ﬁsh
